observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Outdoor street or village pathway lined with traditional wooden houses, with spectators watching from verandas and along the sides
observation.dancers: Multiple male dancers in elaborate full-body costumes
observation.formation_and_space: Procession moving down a dirt or paved village lane in a staggered line or loose single file
observation.posture: Upright to slightly leaning torso, knees relaxed with rhythmic bouncing
observation.footwork: Rhythmic stepping and stomping accompanying the percussion beats; exact foot placement cannot be seen under heavy leaf fringes
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms held loosely at sides or moving rhythmically, mostly obscured by hanging foliage and costume elements
observation.hips_and_torso: Subtle torso bouncing and weight shifting
observation.partnering: None, solo dancing within a procession
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Low level foot stomping, occasional turning or shifting direction
observation.costume_and_props: Elaborate carved wooden masks with protruding teeth and eyes, large feathered headdresses with black and white patterns, capes with hanging ribbons and cowrie shells, and heavy skirts made of layered green leaves or grass
